method.name: Wilson score interval
method.role: sampling-uncertainty calibration only; not research-value scoring or selector authority

claims: The raw 5/5 and RFM 4/5 top-choice point rates are not statistically separated by these small replicate counts; their Wilson 95% intervals overlap materially.
Zero negative-control top choices in ten trials does not establish zero future error probability; the 95% Wilson upper bound remains about 0.278.
Ten of ten negative-control deferrals supports admission awareness but the 95% Wilson lower bound remains about 0.722.
These intervals calibrate repeated selector observations only. They do not identify selection regret, research value, causal superiority, or population-level Provider behavior.
